productionMetricQueries.jobs: SELECT count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive")::int AS active, count(DISTINCT "companyId") FILTER (WHERE "isActive")::int AS companies, count(DISTINCT "countryCode") FILTER (WHERE "isActive")::int AS countries, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND "lastSeenAt"<now()-interval '48 hours')::int AS stale48h, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND "validThrough"<now())::int AS past_expiry, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND length(coalesce(description,''))<200)::int AS short_description, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND "countryCode" IS NULL)::int AS missing_country, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND "countryIntegrity" IS NOT NULL)::int AS uncertain_country, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND city IS NULL)::int AS missing_city, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "isActive" AND "salaryMin" IS NOT NULL AND "salaryCurrency" IS NULL)::int AS salary_without_currency FROM "Job"
productionMetricQueries.sources: SELECT status,"lastRunStatus",count(*)::int AS count FROM "Source" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
productionMetricQueries.top: SELECT c.name, count(*)::int AS jobs FROM "Job" j JOIN "Company" c ON c.id=j."companyId" WHERE j."isActive" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
productionMetricQueries.source_freshness: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE "lastRunAt"<now()-interval '48 hours')::int AS stale48h, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "robotsCheckedAt" IS NULL)::int AS no_robots_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "robotsVerdict" IS NULL)::int AS no_robots, min("lastRunAt") AS oldest_run FROM "Source" WHERE status='ACTIVE'
productionMetricQueries.integrity: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE j."isActive" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "JobSource" s WHERE s."jobId"=j.id AND s."isActive"))::int AS live_without_active_source, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j."isActive" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "JobSource" s WHERE s."jobId"=j.id AND s."isActive" AND s.url=j.url))::int AS live_canonical_not_active FROM "Job" j
productionMetricQueries.raw: SELECT count(*)::int AS sources,count(*) FILTER (WHERE raw IS NULL)::int AS sources_without_raw FROM "JobSource"
productionMetricQueries.snapshots: SELECT min(date),max(date),count(DISTINCT date)::int AS days FROM "MarketSnapshot"
productionMetricQueries.indexes: SELECT indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='Job'
